description:
Works with the project team to ensure standard quality practices/processes are met before proceeding to production. 

Leads a Quality Assurance (QA) team within Mobile Application.

Manages onsite and offshore associates and is responsible for overall QA delivery of Mobile Application.

Provides management oversight, scheduling and technical indepthness for Automation

Coordination for onsite / offshore QA activities performed by the QA Team in support of systems and software projects.

Have technical knowledge of Mobile Applications (iOS and Android) 
and Appium Automation framework to guide and coach the team in 
Automation.

Conducts end-to-end testing on applications and technology, to 
ensure that business, technical, functional requirements are being met 
throughout the Agile SDLC. 




 All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.
